date.as_written: guṇāganande śaśivikramābde jyaṣṭhaś ca kṛṣ(kvakṣye)tṛtīyā ca mandai

purpose: for the abhiṣeka of Garuḍadhvaja (Viṣṇu), offered to Trivikrama (samarpitaṃ Trivikramāya)
notes: The catalogue conflates the names and surroundings into 'Viṣṇukailāśānandarāja upādhyāya'. The meter and sandhi reveal three individuals: Viṣṇu (viṣṇuś ca), Kailāśa (kailāśa[ḥ]), and Ānandaśarman (ānandaśarmmā), described as 'abhiṣekakāmā[ḥ]' (plural). 'Dolāgiri campakavṛkṣamūle' refers to the famous champak tree shrine of Viṣṇu at Dolādri/Dolāgiri (Changu Narayan); Garuḍadhvaja, Lakṣmīpati, and Trivikrama are epithets of the deity Viṣṇu worshipped there.
